name: Madolche Ticket
effectText: If another "Madolche" card(s) in your face-up field or GY is added to your hand or shuffled into your Main Deck by card effect: Add 1 "Madolche" monster from your Deck to your hand, or if you control a Fairy "Madolche" monster, you can Special Summon that monster in Attack Position instead. You can only use this effect of "Madolche Ticket" once per turn.
